dispatcharr.setup.copy.value: Enter your Dispatcharr server's address and the username and password you sign in to it with. This TV keeps an API key, never your password.
dispatcharr.setup.copy.description: Setup screen explanation beside the sign-in form

dispatcharr.setup.address.description: Setup field label: the server's address

dispatcharr.setup.address_example.description: Placeholder in the empty address field: an example address after a translated lead-in

dispatcharr.setup.empty_field.description: Placeholder in an empty username or password field

dispatcharr.setup.plaintext.description: Note under an http:// address: credentials are not encrypted on the network

dispatcharr.setup.missing.description: Setup: Sign in pressed with a field left empty

dispatcharr.setup.bad_address.value: That is not a server address. Try one like 192.0.2.10:9191.
dispatcharr.setup.bad_address.description: Setup failure: the address typed is not a server address

dispatcharr.setup.unreachable.value: Nothing answered at that address. Check it, and that the server is running.
dispatcharr.setup.unreachable.description: Setup failure: nothing answered at the address

dispatcharr.setup.not_dispatcharr.value: Something answered at that address, but it is not Dispatcharr.
dispatcharr.setup.not_dispatcharr.description: Setup failure: the address answered but is not Dispatcharr

dispatcharr.setup.forbidden.value: The server refused this TV. Check Dispatcharr's network access settings.
dispatcharr.setup.forbidden.description: Setup failure: 403, the server's network policy refuses this TV

dispatcharr.setup.throttled.value: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
dispatcharr.setup.throttled.description: Setup failure: 429, too many sign-in attempts

dispatcharr.setup.unavailable.value: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
dispatcharr.setup.unavailable.description: Setup failure: 503, the server is up but busy

dispatcharr.setup.unexpected.value: The server gave an unexpected answer ({detail}).
dispatcharr.setup.unexpected.description: Setup failure: any other answer; {detail} is a short technical description such as HTTP 500

dispatcharr.setup.save_failed.value: Signed in, but this TV could not save the sign-in.
dispatcharr.setup.save_failed.description: Setup failure: signed in but the sign-in could not be stored

dispatcharr.setup.signed_in_as.description: Under the connected verdict: {server} is the server's address, {username} the account

dispatcharr.setup.channels.description: Under the connected verdict: how many channels the account can watch

dispatcharr.setup.channels_failed.value: The channel list could not be read.
dispatcharr.setup.channels_failed.description: Under the connected verdict: the channel list could not be read

dispatcharr.setup.until_reboot.value: Saved only until this TV restarts.
dispatcharr.setup.until_reboot.description: Note under the connected verdict: the sign-in was saved only until the TV restarts

dispatcharr.guide.account.description: Guide header button: opens the page naming the Dispatcharr server and account, with Sign out

dispatcharr.guide.loading.description: Guide status while the channels and programmes are being read

dispatcharr.guide.empty.description: Guide verdict when the signed-in account can watch no channels

dispatcharr.guide.empty_reason.value: Add channels to this account in Dispatcharr, then come back.
dispatcharr.guide.empty_reason.description: Under the 'No channels' verdict: what to do about it

dispatcharr.guide.failed.description: Guide verdict when the channels or programmes could not be read

dispatcharr.guide.refused.value: The server no longer accepts this TV's key. Sign in again.
dispatcharr.guide.refused.description: Under the failed guide verdict: the stored API key was refused

dispatcharr.guide.retry.description: Guide failure action: read the guide again

dispatcharr.guide.sign_in_again.description: Guide failure action when the key was refused: back to the sign-in form

dispatcharr.guide.unlisted.description: A guide cell (and the detail title) for a stretch of time the server lists no programme for

dispatcharr.guide.time_range.description: A programme's times: {start} and {end} are clock times in the viewer's format

dispatcharr.guide.season_episode.description: A programme's season and episode numbers, abbreviated

dispatcharr.guide.episode.description: A programme's episode number when the listing gives no season

dispatcharr.live.no_channel.description: Live TV: the number typed on the remote matches no channel in the lineup

dispatcharr.guide.favourites.description: Guide header switch, while every channel is shown: show only the favourite channels

dispatcharr.guide.all_channels.description: Guide header switch, while only favourites are shown: show every channel again

dispatcharr.guide.all_groups.description: Guide header switch, while every channel group is shown; OK steps to the first group (the switch then shows that group's name)

dispatcharr.guide.no_favourites.description: Guide verdict when only favourites are shown and there are none

dispatcharr.guide.no_favourites_reason.value: Hold OK on a channel to add it to your favourites.
dispatcharr.guide.no_favourites_reason.description: Under 'No favourites yet': how to add one

dispatcharr.setup.resume_on.value: Start on the last channel: On
dispatcharr.setup.resume_on.description: Server page switch, while on: the app opens playing the channel watched last. OK turns it off

dispatcharr.setup.resume_off.value: Start on the last channel: Off
dispatcharr.setup.resume_off.description: Server page switch, while off: the app opens on the Guide. OK turns it on

dispatcharr.setup.resume_note.value: When on, the app opens playing the channel you watched last. BACK goes to the Guide.
dispatcharr.setup.resume_note.description: Under the start-on-the-last-channel switch: what it does

dispatcharr.live.up_next.description: Live TV banner, right-hand column heading over the next programme's title. {time} is its start, a clock time in the viewer's format

dispatcharr.live.browse_hint.description: Live TV banner while UP/DOWN browse another channel without changing to it: pressing OK on the remote changes to the channel shown

dispatcharr.setup.searching.value: Looking for Dispatcharr on your network…
dispatcharr.setup.searching.description: Note under the address field while the TV searches its network for a Dispatcharr server

dispatcharr.setup.found.value: Found on your network · not encrypted
dispatcharr.setup.found.description: Note under an address the TV found on its own network (always plain HTTP, so not encrypted)

dispatcharr.live.unsupported_video.value: This channel's video format can't play on this TV
dispatcharr.live.unsupported_video.description: Failure reason when a live channel's stream is in a video codec the TV's playback pipeline does not take (e.g. MPEG-2)

dispatcharr.live.unsupported_help.value: The channel sends {codec} video. In Dispatcharr, give it a stream profile that converts to H.264.
dispatcharr.live.unsupported_help.description: Under the unsupported-video reason: which codec, and the fix on the server
